challenges.prompt: Implement psi (binned population stability index using the reference range, clamping out-of-range live values), level (stable / moderate / significant) and a two-sample KS statistic. Compare a live sample from the same distribution with one whose mean has shifted.
challenges.starter:

    return 0.0

def ks(a, b):

ref = [i / 10 for i in range(100)]                       # training feature: roughly uniform 0..9.9
same = [i / 10 + 0.05 for i in range(100)]               # same distribution
